scope: Implement one bounded canonical mining-tool equipment slice over the accepted P4 product lineage: equip and unequip an existing canonical Item Graph item through server-authoritative operations, replicate the exact equipped relation, restore it on reconnect, and require the equipped mining tool for the existing canonical ResourceMining action without creating a second item, equipment, persistence, or network authority truth.
required_outputs: Canonical equipment relation bound to existing Item Graph item identity
Server-authoritative equip and unequip command path
Invalid ownership and slot rejection evidence
Mining validation against exact equipped mining tool
Existing canonical P3 resource output preserved exact-once
Fresh evidence map, Reviewer PASS and Verifier PASS before P5 checkpoint proposal
stop_conditions: A second Item Graph or private equipment inventory truth would be required
A new persistence owner or private P5 save format would be required
A network protocol, authority, prediction, or reconciliation foundation change would be required; fail closed to NX/foundation decision
A second pre-H0.3 runtime mutation worker would be required
The exact accepted P4 predecessor base cannot be proven
Production mutation escapes the bounded equipment/tool scope
risk_reasons: Composes Item Graph, multiplayer replication, reconnect recovery, and ResourceMining
Must prevent duplicate canonical equipment or item identity

design_brief.problem_statement: The accepted V0 product can mine and construct with canonical ore, but canonical items cannot yet become authoritative equipped tools consumed by gameplay rules.
design_brief.current_behavior: Item identity and possession are canonical in the M4 Item Graph and ResourceMining already produces canonical output, while equipment/tool state is not yet a bounded authoritative product relation on the accepted P4 lineage.
design_brief.desired_behavior: A player equips one owned canonical mining-tool item through the server, all replicas observe the same equipped item and slot, reconnect restores it, and authoritative mining validates that exact equipped tool before producing the existing canonical resource output.
alternatives_considered: Treat character presentation attachment as canonical equipment truth
Store only a client-side selected-tool flag
Add the minimum server-authoritative equipment relation over existing canonical Item Graph identity
design_brief.selected_design: Add the minimum canonical equipment relation and equip/unequip operations over existing Item Graph item identity, reuse the current command/replication path, and make ResourceMining validate the canonical relation rather than presentation state.
design_brief.why_selected: It adds the product capability while preserving one item identity, one persistence boundary, and one network authority path.
non_goals: No new persistence or network foundation
expected_risks: Equipped item duplicated between inventory and slot
Stale/replayed equip command causes divergent relation
Mining trusts presentation state instead of canonical equipped relation
validation_plan: Inventory existing Item Graph, CH presentation donor, ResourceMining, persistence and command entry points
Freeze equipment relation and command contract before broad implementation
Test owned/unowned/invalid-slot/exact-once equip and canonical unequip
Run two-client replication and reconnect restoration
Require canonical equipped mining tool in ResourceMining and prove existing output exact-once
Run full world regression, post-build critique, independent Reviewer and Verifier
